clips.name: quadtree-zoom
clips.alt: The dancer turning on a dark stage, original left and with Quadtree Zoom right: the dark stage breaks into large flat squares, while her dress, arms and face split into ever smaller tiles that follow her as she moves, and the squares split and merge again as the picture changes
clips.caption: Left: original. Right: Quadtree Zoom at its default settings.

clips.name: quadtree-zoom-presets
clips.alt: The dancer four times in a grid, moving in sync, each with one preset: Fine Print top left with small tiles that trace her outline, Big Tiles top right with her figure in chunky blocks and large squares on the dark stage, Tile Veil bottom left with soft tiles laid over the clear picture, Breathing Grid bottom right with tiles that keep splitting and merging
clips.caption: The four presets on the moving dancer, in sync.

clips.name: quadtree-zoom-minimum-cell
clips.alt: The dancer with Quadtree Zoom while Minimum Cell runs from 2 to 24 px and back: her figure goes from fine tiles that keep her face readable to coarse blocks, and at the top of the range large blocks swallow her until only a faint ghost remains; the current value is shown at the bottom left
clips.caption: Minimum Cell from 2 to 24 px and back.

clips.name: quadtree-zoom-detail-threshold
clips.alt: The dancer with Quadtree Zoom while Detail Threshold runs from 0.003 to 0.08 and back: at the low end the whole picture is split into small tiles, then the stage and then her figure merge into larger and larger blocks until she fades into a few of them, and split again; the current value is shown at the bottom left
clips.caption: Detail Threshold from 0.003 to 0.08 and back.

clips.name: quadtree-zoom-speed
clips.alt: The dancer with Quadtree Zoom at three speeds, about two seconds each: at Speed 0 the tiles only change where she moves, at 1 the blocks slowly split and merge, at 4 they flicker between coarse and fine; the speed is shown at the bottom left
clips.caption: Speed 0, 1 and 4, about two seconds each.
